faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse – II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse – II position is 19th August 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse – II post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Nurse – II position by AIIMS Delhi in this recruitment drive. Candidates are encouraged to apply if they meet the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse – II role?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Project Nurse – II post is a Three year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) Course. Ensure you possess this qualification to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse – II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse – II post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the rules of ICMR/AIIMS for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse – II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Nurse – II position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000 plus HRA as admissible. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse – II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Nurse – II recruitment will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature. Candidates will be appointed on a contract basis for the Project Nurse – II position.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Delhi, specifically New Delhi, as AIIMS Delhi is the recruiting organization.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-08-2026. You can use the 'Apply Online' link provided in the Important Links section or visit the official AIIMS Delhi website.
